content_sections.heading: About PESCO
content_sections.text: Punjab Ex-Servicemen Corporation is a Punjab Government Undertaking with its head office in Sector 34-A, Chandigarh. The notice describes its work as finding employment and self-employment avenues for Ex-Servicemen, widows and dependents, and it can provide specialised manpower or security services under tenders.

content_sections.heading: PESCO Deputy General Manager Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Working knowledge of Punjabi Punjab Domicile Proficiency in computers Medically fit Experienced retired Defence Services officer of the rank of Col/Lt Col/Maj or equivalent, with good knowledge of computers as OIC/Administrator Master Degree in Computer Science, IT, Info Systems or Software Engineer Experience: 5-10 years Vendor certification like SAP Certified Application Associate, Oracle / ERP Certification, Scrum Master / Agile Certifications Punjabi proficiency - 10 certificate and Punjab domicile mandatory Preferred: candidates from premier institutes like IIT, IIIT or NIT, and ESM candidates. Technical skills listed in the notice: Hands-on experience with major ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, MS Dynamics 365, Ramco etc. Proficiency in database management and query languages like SQL Knowledge of coding / scripting languages (Java, Python, XML) Experience connecting ERP modules with their parts applications, AIPS, cloud infrastructure etc. Ability to run system diagnostics, troubleshoot errors, and handle data migration, backup etc. Framework knowledge of Project Management Data Centre / Network Administrator Network Security and Cyber Security aspects Tableau / data visualisation / report generation tools Suggesting AI tools to be incorporated in the ERP / software used For Field Officers, NCS Portal scraping Experienced retired Commissioned Officer of the Defence Services of the rank of Lt Col/Maj or equivalent, with good knowledge of computers Post Graduate Minimum 5 - 10 years of leadership experience Fluent in English, Punjabi and Hindi Punjab Domicile and Punjabi certificate 10th mandatory Preferred: MBA or equivalent. A resident of Punjab/Chandigarh with an understanding of the Punjab industrial ecosystem is highly desirable. Col/Lt Col/Maj who should have commanded a unit/sub unit/est or equivalent level Check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Duties and Reporting
content_sections.text: The officer will be the Chief Technology Officer of PESCO and overall in charge of its IT setup, covering existing software, legacy database, cyber security, network and ERP implementation. The role includes: Digital transformation of PESCO from manual to a fully automated, paperless, ERP-based system Acting as Single Point of Contact (SPOC) between PESCO and the Software Development Agency Reporting directly to the Managing Director, PESCO and the General Manager (Admin) This strategic leadership position links the workforce of ex-servicemen and dependents with Punjab's industries. The officer acts as primary liaison between PESCO and the private sector, industrial bodies and skill-building agencies, and reports to the Managing Director. The responsibilities are: Regular market research to identify emerging sectors in Punjab/Chandigarh that can absorb ESM manpower Scouting government and private tenders where PESCO can provide specialised manpower or security services Skill gap analysis and liaison Visiting industrial hubs to understand technical and soft skill requirements Connecting with Punjab Skill Development Mission (PSDM), National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and private skilling agencies to design customised bridge courses for retiring ESM/Dependents Ensuring military training is mapped to civilian job roles Identifying small-scale venture opportunities for ESM Any other responsibility given by the Management

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are checked and eligible officers are shortlisted. Only eligible and shortlisted officers are called for interview. The interview date will be intimated later.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: All three appointments are contractual. DGM (IT): the initial contract is for one year, extendable on an annual basis at the discretion of the Management. DGM (Project & Ventures): the job requires regular travel across Punjab and neighbouring states.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PESCO Deputy General Manager Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your bio-data as per format. Attach a copy of your Record of Service, your PPO and a photograph. Email these to [email protected] , or send them by post or deliver them physically to PESCO Head Office, SCO 89-90, Sector 34-A, Chandigarh - 160022.

faq.question: Q1. Can a Non-Ex-Serviceman apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only DGM (IT) is marked ESM or Non-ESM, with an age limit of less than 45 years for Non-Ex-Servicemen. The other two posts are marked ESM.

faq.question: Q2. What rank is needed for DGM (Project & Ventures)?
faq.answer: Lt Col/Maj or equivalent. DGM (IT) and DGM (Security) also accept the rank of Col.

faq.question: Q3. Which districts does DGM (Security) cover?
Q4. Which documents go with the bio-data?
faq.answer: A copy of the Record of Service, the PPO and a photograph.

faq.question: Q5. Is a Punjabi certificate compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes for DGM (Project & Ventures), which requires a Punjabi certificate 10th. DGM (IT) also lists Punjabi proficiency with a 10 certificate as mandatory.

faq.question: Q6. How much experience does DGM (IT) require?
faq.answer: The notice asks for 5-10 years, along with hands-on experience of ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, MS Dynamics 365 or Ramco.

faq.question: Q7. Does an IIT, IIIT or NIT degree matter for DGM (IT)?
faq.answer: It is not mandatory, but candidates from such premier institutes will be given preference.

faq.question: Q8. Who does the DGM (IT) report to?
faq.answer: The Managing Director, PESCO and the General Manager (Admin).

faq.question: Q9. Is there a phone number for PESCO?
faq.answer: The notice prints 0172-2620423 for the corporation's Sector 34-A office in Chandigarh.
